Conservative historical root-coordinate bounds must then be disjoint from the prospective root-coordinate bounds by more than 0.003 m in at least one required component.

dist.sufficient_proof_rule: A no-plate exclusion would require a complete hash-bound historical fixture/asset inventory and runtime reset identity proving that the exact scored reference set contains no plate. Otherwise the historical source is incomparable for DIST, not safely declared non-duplicate.
